patch_description: This crossover preserves the current program’s full interaction graph and independently trainable RY layer while adopting selective phase sharing from the stronger, better-generalizing candidate. RZ parameters are tied on the peripheral symmetry pairs (1,4) and (5,6), while the central high-connectivity qubits 2 and 3 remain independent. This provides moderate regularization and improved parameter efficiency without imposing all phase symmetries that previously reduced validation accuracy.
